opening.french: Les noms des Divinités qui naquirent dans la Plaine du Haut-Ciel lorsque commencèrent le Ciel et la Terre furent la Divinité Maître-de-l'Auguste-Centre-du-Ciel, puis la Divinité Haute-Auguste-Merveilleuse-Productrice, puis la Divinité Divine-Merveilleuse-Productrice. Ces trois Divinités naquirent toutes seules, et cachèrent leur personne.
opening.original: The names of the Deities that were born in the Plain of High Heaven when the Heaven and Earth began were the Deity Master-of-the-August-Centre-of-Heaven, next the High-August-Producing-Wondrous Deity, next the Divine-Producing-Wondrous-Deity. These three Deities were all Deities born alone, and hid their persons.

closing.french:
Le Souverain Céleste Hatsuse-be-no-waka-sazaki demeura au palais de Shibakaki, à Kurahashi, et gouverna l'Empire pendant quatre ans. Son auguste mausolée est sur le tertre de Kurahashi.
Son Augustesse Toyo-mike-kashiki-ya-hime demeura au palais d'Owarida, et gouverna l'Empire pendant trente-sept ans. Son auguste mausolée, qui se trouvait sur le tertre d'Ōno, fut ensuite transféré dans la grande sépulture de Shinaga.
closing.original:
The Heavenly Sovereign Hatsuse-be-no-waka-sazaki dwelt at the Palace of Shibakaki at Kurahashi, and ruled the Empire for four years. His august mausoleum is on the mound of Kurahashi.
Her Augustness Toyo-mike-kashiki-ya-hime dwelt at the Palace of Woharida, and ruled the Empire for thirty-seven years. Her august mausoleum, which had been on the mound of Ohonu, was afterwards removed to the great sepulchre at Shinaga.
